Line of best fit
A line of best fit follows the center of a scatterplot trend. Most points will not lie exactly on it.
Slope and intercept
Write the model y equals m x plus b. Slope m is predicted change in y per one unit x.
Choose line points
For a graphical slope estimate, use two readable points ON the fitted line, not two random data points.
Slope example
Through two five and six thirteen, slope equals eight divided by four, or two.
Intercept
With slope two and point two five, the intercept is one. The line is y equals two x plus one.
Prediction
For y equals two x plus three, at x seven predicted y equals seventeen.
Residuals
Residual equals observed minus predicted. If observed is fifteen and predicted is twelve, residual is plus three.
Interpolation
A prediction inside the observed x range is interpolation. Outside that range is extrapolation and may be unreliable.
Verified fit
For the five plotted data points, the least squares fitted line is exactly y equals two x plus one.
Exam strategy
Read slope and intercept, substitute for predictions, and keep residual signs and units correct.
Caution
A line of best fit describes association. It does not by itself establish causation.
